notes.title: Update20241029
notes.content: Fixed the error where the game could not start in special circumstances

notes.title: Update20241027
notes.content:
[New] Added five new Pretty Derby character mods in the Workshop: "Taiki Shuttle," "Tokai Teio," "Gold Ship," "Narita Brian," and "Daiwa Scarlet."

[Optimization] Lowered the probability for the first place to obtain "Ice Fang" from 90% to 70%.
Reversed the inner and outer starting lanes on "Ice Arena," "Toy Arena," and "Dream Temple" courses. Now, the inner-lane players start further ahead.

notes.title: Update20241026B
notes.content:
New Additions:
1.Added an option to hide the UI in the character selection interface of the Bounty Derby.
2.Added “Tayu Momoko” to the Steam Workshop.

Optimizations:
Reduced the number of laps in the third season of the Bounty Derby Race from 2 to 1.

Fixes:
1.Fixed a UI error caused by pressing the “Retry” or “Exit Level” buttons in the pause menu before reaching the finish line.
2.Fixed a UI error that occurred when the player crossed the finish line after being lapped by an opponent.
3.Fixed the issue where Anubis had no shadow.
4.Fixed the issue where holding both the backward and forward buttons simultaneously triggered the initial acceleration effect incorrectly.
5.Fixed the display error of action reward names in the Bounty Race after switching languages in the game.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Optimization:

1、Reduced the original season laps of the Bounty Derby from (1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 3) to (1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 2). The total number of laps decreased from 11 to 8.
2、Slightly enhanced the turning sensitivity of the Nun and Yuko.
3、Optimized the achievement activation method. Story-related achievements can now unlock lower-level achievements by completing advanced tasks, compensating for Steam errors that caused achievement activation failures.
4、Optimized some scene collisions.

Fixes:

1、Fixed the issue where the cursor occasionally appeared twice in the random panels of the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Bounty Derby Race.
